settings.heading: Continuing education for clinicians who carry a caseload
settings.subheading: Clinically rigorous training in trauma-informed practice, psychological assessment, and applied clinical reasoning, taught by a practicing psychologist.

settings.heading: Dr. Angela (Niki) Serravalle, PsyD, LPCMH, NCC
settings.body: Founded and led by Dr. Niki Serravalle, licensed clinical psychologist and founder of the Center for Balanced Living. CFBL Institute exists to bridge the gap between clinical theory and applied practice. Our work is grounded in trauma-informed science, nervous system awareness, cultural humility, and the lived complexity of real clinical work.

settings.quote: Training is how clinical knowledge moves from one clinician to the next. I teach because the best of what I learned came from clinicians who showed me how they thought, not just what to do. That is the kind of training I try to offer now.
settings.author: Dr. Angela (Niki) Serravalle

settings.title: Professional Trainings
settings.heading: Professional Trainings
settings.content: Advanced clinical trainings for licensed clinicians and graduate students ready to deepen their work in trauma, evaluation, and nervous system informed care. Built to translate directly into how you assess, conceptualize, and treat.

settings.title: Courses & Certification
settings.heading: Courses & Certification
settings.content: Multi-session courses that build clinical knowledge sequentially, with time to integrate between sessions. For clinicians strengthening their foundation and students building it for the first time.

settings.title: Workshops
settings.heading: Workshops
settings.content: Workshops designed to bring trauma-informed, ecologically grounded, and meaningful learning into accessible, practical conversation.

settings.title: Supervision & Consultation
settings.heading: Supervision & Consultation
settings.content: Individual and group clinical supervision toward licensure, plus EMDR consultation toward EMDRIA certification.

settings.heading: Ways to Learn With Us
settings.subheading: Select an area to read more, then open its full page for details, dates, and registration.

settings.question: Is CE credit available?
settings.answer: CE credit details and eligibility are listed with each training and vary by license type and jurisdiction.

settings.question: Who are the trainings for?
settings.answer: Licensed mental health clinicians (psychologists, LCSWs, LPCs, LMFTs, LMHCs, PMHNPs, MDs) and graduate students in clinical and counseling psychology.

settings.question: What is the format?
settings.answer: Trainings are delivered live online unless otherwise noted, with materials provided to registrants.

settings.heading: Train with us
settings.body: Join a cohort or inquire about supervision and consultation.
